about.title: About the app
about.tagline: AI legal help platform for foreign workers
about.introBody: LawRo is an AI-powered platform that offers legal consultation and contract checks for foreign workers.
about.point1: An AI chatbot backed by legal documents (RAG) answers your legal questions
about.point2: OCR and AI analyze your contract and spot risks
about.chatBody: AI answers questions about labor law, contracts and more
about.contractBody: Upload an image to read your contract with OCR and analyze legal risks
about.languagesBody: Korean, English, Chinese, Vietnamese, Japanese and Thai
about.contactBody: We welcome your questions and feedback about LawRo anytime.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.s1Intro: LawRo collects the following personal information:
s1Items: Chat history and contract check records
privacy.s2Intro: We use the information we collect only for these purposes:
privacy.s3Body: LawRo protects your personal information with industry-standard security. Passwords are stored encrypted.
privacy.s4Body: LawRo does not share your personal information with third parties without your explicit consent, except when required by law.
privacy.s5Body: We keep your information while your account is active and delete it completely when you delete your account, unless the law requires us to keep it.
s6Items: View and correct your personal information
Request deletion of your personal information
privacy.s7Body: For questions about this privacy policy, please use "Contact us" in the app.
privacy.notice: This privacy policy is a legally binding document. By using the service, you agree to this policy.
